key: Energy storage is our core business: lithium battery packs, portable power stations, photovoltaic modules, inverters and complete solar storage systems, together with solar power and electrical engineering projects. Our second business line is remote controls: hundreds of replacement air-conditioner and TV remote models for all major brands, available for wholesale, OEM and bulk orders. With a complete R&D and testing system, we master the core technologies behind high energy density and long cycle life, and every product meets strict performance requirements.
en: Energy storage is our core business: lithium battery packs, portable power stations, photovoltaic modules, inverters and complete solar storage systems, together with solar power and electrical engineering projects. Our second business line is remote controls: hundreds of replacement air-conditioner and TV remote models for all major brands, available for wholesale, OEM and bulk orders. With a complete R&D and testing system, we master the core technologies behind high energy density and long cycle life, and every product meets strict performance requirements.
zh: 公司以储能电池为核心业务，涵盖动力锂电池组、便携式储能电源、光伏组件、逆变器及完整光储系统，并承接光伏发电及电力工程设计施工业务。遥控器是公司另一大主营业务，提供各大品牌空调、电视替换遥控器，型号达数百款，支持批发、OEM定制及大批量订单。依托完善的研发测试体系，公司掌握了高能量密度、长循环寿命电池的核心技术，每件产品均满足严苛的性能要求。

zh: 作为天长市百亿新能源汽车零部件产业基地的重要参与者，先锐新能源积极融入本地新能源产业集群，借助完善的协作配套与产业政策优势，持续提升自主创新能力。未来，公司将继续坚持科技驱动、质量为本，致力于成为区域新能源领域具有较强影响力的企业。
